keyPoints: Jeevit praniyon me kuch khaas lakshan hote hain — gati karna, saans lena, bhojan karna, badhna aur aas-paas ke badlav par pratikriya dena.
Jeev apne aas-paas ke badlav par turant pratikriya dete hain — chhoone par chhuimui ka paudha sikud jaata hai aur tez roshni me aankh ki putli chhoti ho jaati hai.
Sabhi jeevon ko urja ke liye bhojan aur saans ke liye hawa ki zaroorat hoti hai; bina inke jeevan sambhav nahi hai.
Jeev samay ke saath badhte hain — beej se paudha aur navjaat se bada janwar banna vriddhi kehlata hai, jo har jeev me nishchit dhang se hoti hai.
Jeev apne jaise naye jeev paida karte hain; ise prajanan (reproduction) kehte hain, jisse prajati aage badhti hai aur khatm nahi hoti.
Sharir se bekar aur hanikarak padarth bahar nikalna utsarjan (excretion) hai — paseena, mootra aur paudhon ka patte girana iske udaharan hain.
Aam galti: gati ko hi jeevan ka saboot manna; paudhe apni jagah se hilte nahi phir bhi saans lete hain, badhte hain aur pratikriya dete hain, isiliye wo poore jeev hain.
subject: Science
title: Jeevit Praniyon ke Lakshan
